summary: Sterling Infrastructure, Inc., as borrower, along with subsidiary guarantors, entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with lenders and BMO Bank N.A. as agent. The amendment increases borrowing capacity by $1.05 billion, providing revolving loans up to $1.5 billion (with $600M letter of credit sublimit and $50M swingline sublimit) maturing July 2, 2031. The facility includes an incremental facility option up to $500M or 100% EBITDA, plus unlimited amount if leverage ratio ≤ 2.00x. Interest is based on base rate or SOFR plus margin tied to net leverage. This is a routine credit facility amendment/refinancing, not a special situation event.
